scope: Observed positive-stepping counter blocks in one ordinary local Hometown/forward/None/TrafficOn run; not callback tracing, renderer FPS, a universal fixed rate, or network lead/latency calibration.
method: Use complete readable eight-vehicle samples; contiguous block while simulation tick strictly increases between samples; break on zero/decreasing tick or unreadable vehicle sample. Retain blocks with at least10 samples. Rate=(last tick-first tick)/(last monotonic sample time-first time). Endpoints have requested0.1-second sampling uncertainty.
